title: Message Submission
summary: Describes a way for mail clients to submit messages to a server as a distinct step from relaying, and what a submission server should do. This separates sending from relaying and makes policies easier to enforce. It is a proposed standard that was replaced by RFC 4409.

eli5.summary: When you drop a letter in a mailbox, it is handled differently from mail passed between post offices. This describes the special entry point for letters from users.

questions: how does mail submission differ from relay
